feedback: The confession follows the specific preparation contradiction I used, so the solution feels earned at the level of inference. Its explanation of the ordinary retained container and invented pitcher flavoring fits the earlier tests rather than overturning them. Opening the bottle during the preview and the actual transfer are new admissions of acts, but they fill an available opportunity rather than introduce a new decisive clue unavailable before voting. Chip and Elle's confessions convincingly resolve their competing lies, although this resolution is more definite than the pre-vote exclusions. Brie's concern for staff gives the ending emotional force; the step from a disputed supplier charge to murder still feels abrupt.
